listing.name: Luanti (formerly Minetest)
listing.summary: Create and explore voxel worlds with games and mods you choose.

steps.title: Start the complete desktop package
steps.instruction: On Windows, extract the complete portable ZIP into a writable folder and start bin/luanti.exe. On Mac, choose the Intel or Apple Silicon ZIP that matches your computer and open the complete luanti.app. Check the publisher’s releases for future ZIPs.

steps.title: Install Luanti on Linux
steps.instruction: Install org.luanti.luanti from Flathub on x86-64 or ARM64, or use your distribution’s Luanti package. Run the installed launcher and update it with the same package manager.

steps.title: Choose a game and create a world
steps.instruction: Luanti supplies the engine. Install a game such as Minetest Game from ContentDB, or put a compatible game you already have in the user games folder. Select it in Start Game, choose New to create a world, then choose Play Game.

steps.title: Preserve the user folder you play from
steps.instruction: In About, choose Open User Data Directory and keep that entire folder, including worlds, games, mods, textures, mod data and minetest.conf. The Windows portable ZIP uses its top-level folder. Installed Windows typically uses %APPDATA%/Minetest. On Mac retain the application’s Contents/User folder or ~/Library/Application Support/minetest, whichever it uses. Native Linux normally uses ~/.minetest and the current Flatpak uses ~/.var/app/org.luanti.luanti/.minetest. If switching from the older Minetest Flatpak, back up ~/.var/app/net.minetest.Minetest/.minetest first. Keep any separate directory you chose through LUANTI_USER_PATH or the older MINETEST_USER_PATH.

references.title: Use the Android build for your device
references.instruction: Follow the official Android downloads or choose the APK for your device. Upstream provides ARM64, ARMv7, x86 and x86-64 builds. Android and your package source own installation and updates. Before replacing or uninstalling the app, preserve the worlds and other data under Android/data/net.minetest.minetest/files/Minetest.

original_game_review.reason: The retained guide states that Luanti supplies the engine and the player must install/select a separate ContentDB game, such as Minetest Game. Worlds/mods are not one identified original game.
